metadata.method_name: AEN/ANG Safety Metrics Across 4 Model Families
metadata.description: Expanding AEN and ANG safety metrics from Qwen3-4B lineage to 4 model families (Qwen, Llama, Mistral, Gemma) with 20 harmful + 20 benign prompts, bootstrapped 95% CIs, random-weight controls, logit-only baselines, and XSTest refusal rate correlation.
